I intended to write a review after the treatment was complete, but I really couldn't wait.
Please read Google reviews before deciding to get clear aligners here.
Don't believe exaggerated review cases from pages that make false claims.

1. The sales team is extremely pushy. After you inquire, there will be an assessment process costing 3000 baht for the initial scan. Finally, the sales team will pressure you with various conditions and promotions to close the deal quickly within the month. I wasn't impressed by the sales pressure at all. Ideally, don't commit to getting braces here in the first place, or just forfeit the initial payment. Because if you decide to proceed, you may experience endless frustration from DCA clinic.

2. The medical team isn't fully prepared to manage your case throughout the treatment. They only focus on attaching the aligners. As a result, you get examined by whoever is on duty. There's a lack of continuity in treatment. The medical team lacks the knowledge and expertise to perform clear aligner treatment like a specialist.

3. The admin is unprofessional. Appointments are not communicated with in any way. The standards are below par with typical clinics. You have to constantly follow up on appointments yourself. Information is confusing and chaotic. 1. The admin is rambling and doesn't answer questions directly. The management is terrible; it's like they don't even have a patient database in their system. Absolutely awful.

4. The aligners are shoddy, uneven, and don't fit the teeth properly. The quality of the work is low. Ultimately, if the treatment doesn't go according to plan, you end up paying extra, and they take no responsibility. Be wary of this condition, because they definitely won't let you get free treatment. (The aligners are manufactured in a Thai lab, and the quality is questionable – they barely fit the teeth.)

5. The app looks impressive, but it's just AI and practically useless. Even if you try to follow the plan and it doesn't work, you'll end up with additional refinement costs.

Terrible at every stage. Don't waste your money and time on a clinic that's good at advertising but has substandard quality compared to a regular orthodontic clinic. Hopefully, this review will be helpful to anyone considering clear aligner treatment here. Avoid them if you can.
